achievements.name: You're ready now
achievements.description: Complete the ONBOARDING sequence

steps: Start a new game or continue, then finish the full ONBOARDING / tutorial sequence on the mountain.

achievements.name: Upside down
achievements.description: Perform your first double backflip

steps: On skis or snowboard, build speed and pull a double backflip (two full backward rotations) in one jump.

achievements.name: Baby steps
achievements.description: Reach the ROOKIE rank in any field of expertise

steps: Play challenges and free roam in one discipline (ski, snowboard, wingsuit, etc.).
Raise that field of expertise to ROOKIE rank.

achievements.name: Scoring master
achievements.description: Score more than 2000 point in one jump

steps: Chain tricks in one jump (spins, flips, grabs) until the jump score exceeds 2000 points.

achievements.name: You spin around
achievements.description: Perform your first 1080°

steps: In a big air jump, spin until you complete a 1080° (three full rotations) and land it.

achievements.name: Tourist
achievements.description: Find 10 Points of Interest in Alps

steps: Open the map and travel between different mountain sectors.
Visit the required number of distinct zones / drop zones.

achievements.name: Once upon a time
achievements.description: Complete a MOUNTAIN STORY in Alps

steps: Open the Mountain Stories list in the Alps and complete any one story.

achievements.name: Seek...
achievements.description: Find and unlock 10 Drop Zones in Alps

steps: Explore the Alps map and unlock 10 Drop Zones (fast-travel launch points).

achievements.name: Halfway there
achievements.description: Reach REPUTATION level 10

steps: Complete challenges and events to raise your overall progression rank.
Reach the midpoint rank/prestige threshold shown in the progression menu.

achievements.name: Gold-plated challenger
achievements.description: Get 12 Gold Medals on Alps Public Challenges

steps: Earn Gold medals on 12 different Alps Public Challenges.

achievements.name: Crash Test
achievements.description: Fall and endure between 90 and 99.9 Gs

steps: Build huge speed (wingsuit or steep slope) and crash hard.
Survive a fall that registers between 90 and 99.9 Gs on the impact meter.

achievements.name: The end of the World
achievements.description: Reach the end of ALPS game world

steps: Ski/fly to the geographic edge of the Alps playable map until the “end of the world” trigger fires.

achievements.name: The memory remains
achievements.description: Get 1 MEMORABLE MOMENT of each category

steps: Trigger one Memorable Moment in every Memorable Moment category (check the Moments menu filters).

achievements.name: Red-letter day
achievements.description: Get 15 Different MEMORABLE MOMENTS

steps: Collect 15 different Memorable Moments across categories.

achievements.name: Mush!
achievements.description: Stay on the Sled without falling for 30 seconds (Winterfest DLC required)

steps: During Winterfest, hop on the sled.
Stay on the sled for 30 seconds without falling off.

achievements.name: Legend
achievements.description: Reach the LEGEND rank in any field of expertise

steps: Focus one field of expertise (e.g. wingsuit or ski).
Complete challenges and rank events until that field hits LEGEND rank.

achievements.name: Riding rabbit
achievements.description: Take off and land 5 times in the same Speed Riding run (Extreme Pack DLC required)

steps: In a Speed Riding run (Extreme Pack), take off and land five separate times before finishing the run.

achievements.name: The legend starts here
achievements.description: Reach REPUTATION level 25

steps: Finish the opening / onboarding challenges in the Alps.
Complete the first legend path mission when it appears.

achievements.name: Shinier than Gold
achievements.description: Get 7 GOLD MEDALS in the Alps Invitational Challenges

steps: Replay challenges and aim for the highest medal tier.
Earn a Diamond (or top-tier) result on a challenge.

achievements.name: The Dragon
achievements.description: Defeat "The Dragon" during Winterfest

steps: During the Winterfest event, open the event challenge list.
Complete / defeat the “Dragon” Winterfest boss challenge.
warnings: Requires Winterfest Pack / Winterfest event content.

achievements.name: Road to mountain knowledge
achievements.description: Complete 15 MOUNTAIN STORIES in Alps

steps: Open Mountain Stories on the Alps map (story points).
Complete 15 Mountain Stories.

achievements.name: The Fratelli Twins
achievements.description: Defeat "The Fratelli Twins" during Winterfest

steps: In Winterfest challenges, select Fratelli Twins.
Win that event matchup.
warnings: Requires Winterfest Pack / Winterfest event content.

achievements.name: 14 carats Gold challenger
achievements.description: Get 58 Gold Medals on Alps Public Challenges

steps: Replay Alps Public Challenges and improve your lines/score.
Earn Gold on 58 different Alps public challenges.

achievements.name: Super Savoyard
achievements.description: Defeat "Super Savoyard" during Winterfest

steps: Play the Winterfest “Super Savoyard” boss challenge.
Defeat Super Savoyard.
warnings: Requires Winterfest Pack / Winterfest event content.

achievements.name: The legend was not enough
achievements.description: Reach the LEGEND rank in 3 different fields of expertise

steps: Reach LEGEND rank in three different fields of expertise.

achievements.name: Lincoln Black
achievements.description: Defeat "Lincoln Black" during Winterfest

steps: Open Winterfest challenges and select Lincoln Black.
Defeat Lincoln Black.
warnings: Requires Winterfest Pack / Winterfest event content.

achievements.name: King of the Winterfest
achievements.description: Defeat "The Beast" during Winterfest

steps: During Winterfest, challenge and defeat “The Beast” event boss/race.
warnings: Requires Winterfest Pack / Winterfest event content.

achievements.name: Are you ready for this?
achievements.description: Finish the Trial Rogue 4 of Extreme Pack

steps: Complete Trial Rogue 4 in the Extreme Pack trial series.

achievements.name: Legendary legend!
achievements.description: Reach the LEGEND rank in 6 different fields of expertise

steps: Raise expertise in Wing, Race, Freestyle, etc. via challenges.
Reach LEGEND rank in 6 different expertise fields.

achievements.name: I am an eagle!
achievements.description: Fly for 5 minutes with the Rocket Wingsuit (Extreme Pack DLC required)

steps: Equip the Rocket Wingsuit (Extreme Pack).
Accumulate 5 minutes of flight time with it (can be across a long session).

achievements.name: The Extreme Five
achievements.description: Obtain the Gold medal in 5 Challenges of Extreme Pack

steps: In Extreme Pack challenges, earn Gold on 5 different challenges.

achievements.name: Mountain legend
achievements.description: Complete 30 MOUNTAIN STORIES in Alps

steps: Continue clearing Mountain Story nodes across the Alps.
Complete 30 Mountain Stories.

achievements.name: ... and you shall find
achievements.description: Find and unlock 110 Drop Zones in Alps

steps: Fly/explore the Alps and unlock Drop Zones marked on the map.
Unlock 110 Drop Zones.

achievements.name: Shaked by the bell
achievements.description: Fly into and ring the village church bell while wingsuiting

steps: Launch in a wingsuit near a village with a church steeple.
Fly into the church bell to ring it (clip the bell; do not need a perfect landing).

achievements.name: The Extreme Ten
achievements.description: Obtain the Gold medal in 10 Challenges of Extreme Pack

steps: Own/access the Extreme Pack challenges.
Earn Gold on 10 Extreme Pack challenges.

achievements.name: Challenge accepted!
achievements.description: Get 115 Bronze Medals in Alps Public Challenges

steps: Complete Alps Public Challenges for at least Bronze.
Reach 115 Bronze medals on Alps public challenges.

achievements.name: 24 carats Gold challenger
achievements.description: Get 115 Gold Medals on Alps Public Challenges

steps: Gold-grind the full Alps public challenge list.
Earn 115 Gold medals on Alps public challenges.

achievements.name: Tour guide
achievements.description: Find 149 Points of Interest in Alps

steps: Visit POV binoculars / Point of Interest markers around the Alps.
Find 149 Points of Interest.

achievements.name: Like the back of your hand
achievements.description: Reach 100% exploration on one REGION in Alps

steps: Pick one Alps region and fill its exploration meter to 100% (drop zones, POIs, challenges).

achievements.name: No more secrets
achievements.description: Find 110 Drop zones, 115 challenges and 149 Point of Interest in Alps

steps: Unlock 110 Drop Zones, finish 115 challenges, and find 149 Points of Interest in the Alps.
Use map filters to clear remaining markers — this is the full Alps exploration clean-up.
warnings: Long exploration grind — track each category separately on the map.

achievements.name: I can see my house from up there
achievements.description: Safely land after jumping from all the 7 Base Jump Spots in Alaska (Extreme Pack DLC required)

steps: In Alaska (Extreme Pack), jump from each of the 7 Base Jump Spots.
Land safely after every jump — dying or failing a landing voids that spot.
warnings: Requires Extreme Pack DLC (Alaska base jumps).
